invariants.lifecycle: DRAFT -> APPROVED -> RELEASED; CLOSED is terminal in current service surface
invariants.owner_scope: created_by_id and mrp_run_id; no company_id or warehouse_id on plan, warehouse is inherited from MRPRun
invariants.dates: start_date/end_date required; ordering and horizon bounds must be validated by service
invariants.locks: line lock count is denormalized; plan row should serialize release and recalculation
invariants.nullability: mrp_run_id and created_by_id nullable; unscoped run cannot safely feed coupled projection
invariants.transaction: approval/release endpoint uses one AsyncSession transaction; release must roll back as a unit
invariants.permission: mps.approve/mps.release; warehouse/company scope must also be checked
invariants.current_enforcement: approval locks the plan, requires positive FEASIBLE lines, a completed warehouse-scoped MRP run, and an existing actor, then writes an approval audit event; release locks the plan, rechecks source/target warehouse company scope, performs all-or-none recipe-backed production-order creation, audits completion, and makes same-warehouse retries idempotent
invariants.counterexample: No current reproduction found for empty/blocked approval, unscoped release, or duplicate retry in the inspected API path; plan company/warehouse scope remains inherited through MRPRun rather than stored directly
invariants.recommended_fix: retain regression coverage for readiness, source scope, authorization, rollback and retry; keep the inherited warehouse relation explicit in consumers

invariants.owner_scope: mps_id scopes line; product_id points to shared master
invariants.uom: no line UOM; must match Product.uom, demand UOM, recipe/BOM and supply before arithmetic
invariants.dates: period_start/end required; planned dates nullable; within-plan ordering not DB-enforced
invariants.locks: is_locked protects planner overrides; engine must retain locked quantity, dates, WC, and campaign
invariants.uniqueness: line_no globally unique; no plan/product/period uniqueness constraint
invariants.nullability: MRP link, work center, dates, hours, batch and production order nullable
invariants.transaction: generation deletes/recreates unlocked lines; must lock plan and keep deletes/inserts atomic
invariants.permission: mps.edit/calculates; route must bind both plan and line IDs
invariants.current_enforcement: planner update binds plan and line IDs and locks both in parent-first order; validated API capacity includes locked lines in loads/slots, preserves their feasibility, and writes per-line diagnostics; advanced material evaluation rejects missing or mismatched UOM/master data; legacy direct capacity service retains older fallback and locked-line behavior
invariants.counterexample: A direct caller of the legacy scheduler can still encounter its fallback throughput/calendar semantics; the active validated endpoint does not demonstrate the old locked-line omission or UOM-as-feasible cases
invariants.recommended_fix: keep plan-bound update and lock-order tests; keep validated API as the operational path and retire or constrain legacy direct-service fallback semantics

invariants.lifecycle: forecast header must be APPROVED and is_approved; line may carry adjusted_qty override
invariants.owner_scope: header warehouse_id optional; forecasts without exact plan warehouse cannot be safely coupled
invariants.uom: product UOM implied; forecast line has no explicit UOM
invariants.dates: header start/end plus line period_date; period type DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY
invariants.locks: approved forecast should be treated as source snapshot
invariants.uniqueness: header unique by product/period/date/model; line unique by forecast and date
invariants.transaction: demand projection uses one plan transaction
invariants.current_enforcement: advanced demand projection buckets by date, filters approved forecasts and open orders to the exact MRP warehouse, subtracts fulfilled quantities, nets confirmed demand with forecast, and keeps source linkage; legacy aggregate MRP generation still lacks the same delivery-date detail
invariants.counterexample: The legacy aggregate generation path can lose delivery-date detail; the inspected advanced projection filters warehouse scope and nets forecast/confirmed demand rather than reproducing the prior cross-warehouse/double-count cases
invariants.recommended_fix: retain dated, warehouse-scoped projection regression cases and distinguish the legacy aggregate generation path from advanced projection

invariants.lifecycle: confirmed/allocated/picking remain open demand; shipped quantity is fulfilled; cancelled/draft excluded
invariants.owner_scope: order company_id and warehouse_id; project only exact MRP warehouse
invariants.uom: line unit must equal product UOM unless a configured conversion exists
invariants.locks: source orders are never modified by MPS projection
invariants.uniqueness: order no and order-line no unique under SO
invariants.transaction: projection reads only; MPS line writes are atomic
invariants.current_enforcement: MRP demand helper filters order status; plan generator does not retain delivery date detail
invariants.counterexample: Only a legacy/direct call without warehouse scope can include warehouse-null order demand or bypass the advanced projection's order/product UOM check; active advanced projection uses the exact source warehouse and rejects mismatched order UOM
invariants.recommended_fix: filter exact warehouse, honor open statuses and shipped quantities, reject unit mismatch

invariants.lifecycle: stock excludes blocked; open PO approved/ordered/partial; WIP planned/released/in progress
invariants.owner_scope: stock warehouse required; PO company; production target warehouse
invariants.uom: on-hand/reserved/available and incoming quantities must use product/material UOM
invariants.dates: PO expected_delivery_date and WIP scheduled_end determine supply period
invariants.locks: reserved inventory is unavailable; release/order links prevent duplicate supply
invariants.uniqueness: PO line unique by PO/line; production order number globally unique
invariants.nullability: PO product/material alternatives; schedule and actual quantity nullable in source model
invariants.transaction: supply read snapshot plus plan line writes in one transaction
invariants.permission: warehouse/company scope inherited from MRP run
invariants.current_enforcement: advanced projection reads exact-warehouse stock, dated matching-company open PO receipts and eligible WIP, carries available balance forward, and records source scope; legacy MRP-result generation remains aggregate and does not independently reconstruct dated supply components
invariants.counterexample: The legacy aggregate path cannot independently show each dated stock/PO/WIP component; the advanced projector filters and dates these supplies, so the earlier late-PO/blocked-stock examples do not describe that path
invariants.recommended_fix: retain date/scope/conservation tests for advanced projection and avoid presenting aggregate legacy MRP quantities as a dated supply ledger

invariants.lifecycle: BOM APPROVED/RELEASED or Recipe APPROVED, active, and effective for planned date
invariants.owner_scope: product master relation; material components require identified active material
invariants.uom: basis, output UOM, required UOM and material UOM must agree or use explicit conversion
invariants.locks: released source definitions are snapshots for planning
invariants.uniqueness: BOM code; recipe product/version; BOM line no; recipe line no
invariants.nullability: recipe has no output base quantity; legacy MRP scales item quantity per output unit
invariants.transaction: explosion and diagnostics occur within MPS evaluation transaction
invariants.permission: MPS calculate; quality/planner substitution approval required by policy
invariants.current_enforcement: advanced material feasibility uses effective approved/released recursive BOM where available or an effective approved Recipe, applies explicit basis/yield/loss and fails closed on missing or incompatible material UOM; release still requires an effective approved Recipe because ProductionOrder.recipe_id is non-null
invariants.counterexample: A product feasible through BOM-only data can still remain unreleasable because production-order release requires a Recipe; missing effective material definitions are rejected by advanced feasibility rather than treated as zero demand
invariants.recommended_fix: preserve fail-closed effective BOM/Recipe and UOM checks; align release readiness with the Recipe requirement or document/resolve BOM-only release semantics without fabricating recipe data

invariants.lifecycle: only ACTIVE resource and explicit calendar dates can contribute capacity
invariants.owner_scope: work center ID; plan linked to MRP warehouse; source has no direct company scope
invariants.uom: capacity_uom must be a compatible product-UOM per hour rate
invariants.dates: calendar date, shift availability, maintenance/holiday flags, downtime interval
invariants.locks: locked lines consume capacity but may not be rescheduled/recalculated
invariants.nullability: capacity/rate UOM, end_time, duration may be null
invariants.transaction: replace slots and update feasibility atomically
invariants.permission: MPS calculate and scoped work center/plant
invariants.current_enforcement: validated capacity API uses active work centers, compatible rate UOM, explicit calendars, downtime and locked-line load, and preserves unknown inputs; legacy direct scheduler still contains fallback throughput/default calendar behavior
invariants.counterexample: Direct use of the legacy scheduler can still exercise its default rate/calendar assumptions; the active validated endpoint does not use those defaults and does not mark missing calendar/rate evidence FEASIBLE
invariants.recommended_fix: keep validated capacity as the operational route and constrain or retire legacy defaults; preserve explicit unknown/diagnostic evidence

invariants.lifecycle: recalculated snapshot tied to MPS run or planning scenario
invariants.uniqueness: MPS slot unique per plan/work center/date
invariants.transaction: delete/rebuild MPS slots in one transaction
invariants.current_enforcement: validated capacity recomputes plan slots and persists per-line diagnostics with required/available/downtime/overload inputs and source version; legacy slot-only callers may not provide that line-level provenance
invariants.counterexample: The old slot-only path lacks line-level provenance; the active validated API diagnostic path records it, so the unqualified missing-line-reason counterexample is no longer current for that endpoint
invariants.recommended_fix: retain idempotent per-line diagnostic and slot recalculation tests for the validated API path

invariants.lifecycle: campaigns are recalculable only for unlocked lines; locked campaign assignments remain fixed
invariants.owner_scope: plan and work center; product category used only when exact matrix family matches
invariants.dates: campaign start/end from member period range; transitions respect date windows
invariants.locks: locked lines are excluded from regrouping/deletion
invariants.uniqueness: campaign code globally unique; sequence order deterministic per plan
invariants.transaction: rebuild all unlocked campaign assignments atomically
invariants.current_enforcement: the validated API groups exact product IDs, preserves locked assignments, derives family from Product.category, uses only an active exact (work_center_id, from_family, to_family) ChangeoverMatrix row, and records NOT_CONFIGURED diagnostics for absent transitions, CIP duration, and minimum-run quantity; no default time is credited. The legacy direct grouping service still retains prefix grouping/default setup behavior
invariants.counterexample: Product.category is only a family proxy and ChangeoverMatrix has no effective-date or approval fields. Owner data is required before configuration can be authoritative: (1) product-to-family mapping or confirmation that Product.category is authoritative; (2) effective work-center/from-family/to-family changeover minutes with active/approved source and effectivity; (3) CIP duration with its applicable work-center/transition scope, unit, effectivity, and authoritative source; (4) minimum run quantity and matching product UOM with product/work-center scope and effectivity. The current diagnostic correctly leaves CIP/minimum-run unknown
invariants.recommended_fix: retain validated exact-product grouping, lock-preservation, and NOT_CONFIGURED coverage; obtain the listed owner-data contract before crediting changeover, CIP, or minimum-run values; constrain legacy direct grouping semantics

invariants.lifecycle: DRAFT -> COMPUTED; scenario never mutates the live plan
invariants.owner_scope: mps_id and created_by_id; line IDs must belong to plan
invariants.uom: change values validate against target field UOM
invariants.dates: date changes must remain parseable and scenario horizon is explicit
invariants.locks: locked lines cannot be changed by scenario
invariants.nullability: impact metrics nullable; JSON changes have no schema version in the base table
invariants.transaction: scenario and immutable input/result snapshot created in one transaction
invariants.permission: mps.simulate and warehouse scope; creator recorded
invariants.current_enforcement: line IDs are plan-scoped and locked lines are rejected; MERGE requires matching source allocation, product, schedule, work center, batch size, campaign, priority, and feasibility; compatible batch counts are validated and summed; SPLIT requires exactly two positive exact-sum parts aligned to configured batch size; SHIFT_ADD requires FINITE mode and a scheduled work-center date, validates existing calendar shift-window consistency, caps added hours at the remaining 24-hour day, does not infer an added-shift interval, and leaves hours uncredited when same-day downtime overlap cannot be ruled out; versioned assumptions and candidate results are persisted without mutating live lines; unsupported cost basis remains unknown. The real Playwright roundtrip spec selects only finite plans with the hardcoded disposable M20-OPS-PLAN- prefix and requires M20_DISPOSABLE_TEST_DATABASE=1 before login or API access. A fresh task-owned PostgreSQL 16 run passed 1 browser test after Alembic upgrade to 20261022_0011; scenario create returned 201 and the saved SPLIT with 100.0% service level/0 delay remained visible after reload. Screenshot and exact run details are in the M20.S01.T003 evidence log
invariants.counterexample: The mocked scenario-operations E2E alone proves only request serialization. The separate real browser/API/PostgreSQL test has a fresh task-owned execution recorded in project-control/codex/jobs/M20.S01.T003/evidence/mps-sequence-checks-2026-10-22.md, with migration, synthetic prefixed plan/line, API status receipts, and a post-reload screenshot. The opt-in guard alone does not prove an arbitrary target database is disposable; this run used its own task-created PostgreSQL container. Owner production data was not used. Cost basis and owner-data-dependent outputs remain unknown
invariants.recommended_fix: retain regression coverage for aggregate shifts, downtime uncertainty, and batch-conserving structural changes; preserve independent audit of the recorded roundtrip source/log/screenshot and rerun after relevant source or test changes only against a task-owned disposable M20 database; require an owner-approved cost basis (hourly or unit/recipe basis), amount/rate, ISO currency, effective dates, source, and any FX conversion policy before reporting monetary impact

invariants.lifecycle: DRAFT approval requires readiness; APPROVED release all-or-none; RELEASED retry must not duplicate orders
invariants.owner_scope: actual actor, plan, inherited warehouse/company scope
invariants.uom: production order UOM from Product; no hard-coded KG
invariants.dates: scheduled interval is planned line date within plan horizon
invariants.locks: released production_order_id prevents line release duplication
invariants.uniqueness: production order number unique; MPS sequence monotonic under concurrency
invariants.nullability: actor can be null only where source user is unavailable; authenticated routes have principal
invariants.transaction: all production orders, line links, plan state, and audit event in one transaction
invariants.permission: mps.approve/release plus warehouse/company scope; segregation policy not explicitly configured
invariants.current_enforcement: approval/release row-lock plans and write audit events; approval requires positive FEASIBLE lines and a completed scoped run; release checks actual endpoint permissions and same-company warehouse scope, rolls back incomplete release, allocates monotonic PO numbers, and validates idempotent retry; release still requires effective approved Recipe data
invariants.counterexample: No current reproduction found for blocked-line approval, cross-company release, partial order creation, or duplicate same-target retry in the inspected endpoint path; BOM-only feasibility remains distinct from Recipe-backed release eligibility
invariants.recommended_fix: retain readiness/scope/rollback/idempotency tests and resolve documented BOM-only versus Recipe-backed release semantics without weakening authenticated scope
